Portfolio.subtitle: I'm Seraphina, a character designer & illustrator. My world is floating white linen, delicate gold jewelry and creamy-grey wings — exactly in this ivory tone you see.
Portfolio.note: To use your own art, drop it as angel-reference.jpg inside public/
Portfolio.marquee: soft makeup • tired eyes • gold jewelry • white wings • chain details • back view • draped linen
Portfolio.sheetDesc: Every margin note from the original sketch turned into its own card — from tired makeup to golden chains.
Portfolio.card1D: Layered chains, teardrop pendant and waist rings. Brassy gold resting on pale skin.
Portfolio.card2D: Blurred pink shadow, glossy tears and a weary gaze. Innocence mixed with fatigue.
Portfolio.card3D: Knotted crop top and long slitted skirt. White linen with soft floating folds.
Portfolio.card4D: White feathers with creamy shade and golden-brown tips. Three states: folded, open, fallen.
Portfolio.card5D: Cross back lacing, tiny shoulder tattoo and wavy black hair. Long slender silhouette.
Portfolio.card6D: Waist chain with beads and a long pendant. The joint between top and bottom.
Portfolio.worksDesc: Four moods close to this ivory-cream tone. Hover to see details.
Portfolio.servicesDesc: From idea to full sheet, in this same soft style and cream-gold palette.
Portfolio.srv1D: Silhouette, face, outfit and palette. Two revision rounds included.
Portfolio.srv2D: Front, back, expressions, jewelry and wing details — like this piece.
Portfolio.srv3D: Floating fabric, chains and accessories with real texture refs.
Portfolio.srv4D: One full story frame with soft light and paper grain.
Portfolio.step2D: Face, fabric and wings in detail
Portfolio.aboutText: I love curly black-haired girls with white wings. My work mixes shaky hand lines, watercolor shading and tiny sheet annotations. If you are after something soft, sad and noble, you are home.
Portfolio.contactTitle: Let the next angel be yours
Portfolio.contactDesc: This month's capacity: 2 slots. I usually reply within 24 hours.

About.title: About this template
About.description: This project is a ready-to-use template for quickly starting Next.js projects. Its main goal is to provide a clean, optimized and reusable structure that follows the DRY principle.
About.archDesc: This project follows a Monolithic architecture, meaning all frontend parts live together in a single, unified project.

Footer.text: Seraphina Atelier — drawn with love, in cream & gold ✦
